visual_review_notes: Inspected all eleven final encoded contact sheets: task/method/results cards and initial, pour, stop vicinity and final views for each of twenty distinct cases.
Task and wrist images are visible and preserve the source framing; native camera crop comparisons also pass.
Attempt numbers, final-result labels, phase labels and playback speed are legible; empty-bottle labels explicitly identify final remaining liquid.
Success-only selection, 23/30 source benchmark, 1/14 later wider-layout result and transient-particle measurement limits are stated in the video.
All twenty final views show the bottle upright after return/release. Review is of selected frames plus complete decoder validation, not a claim of continuous human video playback.
